# holding quantity

The quantity of the asset held, as an xsd:decimal. Functional: a holding has exactly one quantity at a given point in time (competing standpoint-indexed quantities coexist as separate statements).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/holdingQuantity>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:holdingQuantity`  

**Type:** `owl:DatatypeProperty`, `owl:FunctionalProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/finance>
